minutes.summary: The board made bylaw review and TCP building design committee appointments, heard the Open Space chair propose an open process for the future of two town-owned parcels, and proclaimed Pride Month and accepted a pride flag. It also accepted donated bleachers, ratified annual and police appointments, adopted the state emergency paid sick leave policy, and heard the town manager's COVID and department updates.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to accept the Pride Month proclamation and to accept a donated pride flag and coordinate a flag raising in town center.
The Open Space chair proposed an open process to gather board and public input on two town-owned parcels; the board encouraged it.
The board adopted the state emergency paid sick leave policy as written, which runs through September 30th or until state funding is exhausted.
The board appointed members to the bylaw review committee and the TCP building design committee, and ratified town manager and police appointments.
The board accepted donated bleachers for McNally park; a senior discount on trash bags was deferred for further thought.

why_it_matters: The Open Space process could set how Pleasant Street and West Street parcels are used, and designating land for conservation or parks can open state grant eligibility that general town land lacks.
The trash bag bid drew a single bidder, so the FY22 price increase residents may pay is still to be recommended.
watch_next: June 15th: the town manager's recommendation on the trash bag bid and the proposed FY22 increase.
Open Space Committee's draft open process for the Pleasant Street and West Street parcels.
